newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 24.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these
items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Work on a third bridge across Abidjan's lagoon between the districts of Riviera and Marcory will begin in March 1998, according to an official statement after Wednesday's cabinet meeting. France's Bouygues will lead the group
- Weapons brought over into Ivory Coast during the Liberian
civil war are still circulating in the west of the country, where many refugees have settled. Three people were arrested for possessing such arms earlier in July.

- The head of the SYNTTCI transporters federation complains that, despite government plans to remove them, there are more and more police checkpoints along the roads; says they slow down freight. Freight from Mali and Burkina Faso will shun the port of Abidjan and go via Togo if this carries on, he says. - A meeting of small producers opposes the dismantling of the Caisse de Stabilisation, the body that formerly sold all the cocoa and coffee in Ivory Coast. They say the Caisse should be a buffer between them and the free market demanded by aid donors. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
